About this publication

This is my space for documenting what I learn, the experiences I gain, and the ideas I explore while working with technology.

I write about software engineering, Linux, open source, development tools, and the lessons that come from building and experimenting.

The goal is simple: learn openly, share useful knowledge, and keep improving.

You can find my work on GitHub, connect with me on LinkedIn, or reach me at email.
